scope: All eight numbered native 512px images viewed separately; warmup excluded. No inference rerun or image editing. Subjective visual review, not automated attractiveness or identity classification.
criteria: Recognizable priest appearance without requiring an exact Roman tab; native-size photographic quality, intact adult masculine face, bare head, calendar appeal and diversity.

entries.notes: Clearly recognizable clerical collar and black shirt. Adult face, eyes and smiling teeth are coherent, but face and neck are waxy with flattened cheek gradients and uniform skin texture. Smooth artificial appearance persists at native512; not a convincing photograph.

Priest collar remains clear despite strange heavily textured knit/mesh shirt beneath jacket. Eyes and smile are coherent but face looks like a polished 3D character, with very uniform beard and forehead texture. No hat or extra subject.

Recognizable priest with white clerical tab and black high-neck garment. Face/eyes structurally intact, but glossy almost metallic cheeks/forehead and pale edged lips look rendered. Chest clasp and hanging ornament are irregular but not the main failure.

Recognizable clerical collar, bareheaded adult man, coherent face and eyes. Low-detail face has an artificial sheen; an overlaid distressed film-border/scratch treatment further separates this from a clean photographic portrait. Subject is centered and not grossly malformed.

Black high-neck garment with white center neck detail reads as clerical, though white jacket and collar shape are unusual. Face is unmistakably rendered: metallic highlights, vertical streaks across cheeks/neck, hard smooth surfaces and painted hair. Anatomical eye arrangement is intact, but visual quality fails strongly.

Clear priest collar and white stole-like garment over black shirt. This is the most photographic-looking sample in the cohort, with coherent eyes and smile; skin still has strong beauty-filter smoothing and uniformly stippled detail, and collar has a slightly translucent edge over neck. Not yet at requested natural photographic standard.

Adult silver-haired face with coherent eyes and beard, still evenly smoothed/rendered in texture. Clothing is an ordinary light pointed-collar shirt with black placket and buttons; no recognizable priest signal. Background coherent enough but soft.

Clear white priest tab, black clerical shirt and jacket. Mature adult face, beard and eyes are coherent, but forehead wrinkle bands, cheek smoothing, beard strands and hair have a sculpted synthetic character rather than photographic irregularity. No hat.

summary.major_problem: Persistent waxy/metallic skin and uniform synthetic texture. Clearer priest clothing than the prior1024cohort does not repair photographic fidelity.
summary.comparison_to_1024_review: This 512px cohort has 7/8 recognizable priests versus 3/8 clear and 1/8 uncertain in the prior 1024px review. Neither cohort reaches requested photographic quality. The apparent clothing gain is an observed cohort difference, not proof that resolution causes better prompt following. Image 004 is particularly rendered, while 005 is comparatively more photographic.
summary.diversity: Visible variation in age impression, complexion, beard, pose and framing; still idealized facial features and repeated smooth portrait style. 006/007addolderappearance;000/001and004/005showfamilyresemblance. Eight images cannot establish broad latent identity diversity.
summary.recommendation: Do not deploy this unadapted 512px two-step model. Prefer another base if native photographic texture is already better; retain as adaptation control only. Training needs to improve natural skin and garment consistency while preserving fast inference.
